sloka: नाम स्वं श्रावयन् रामो ववन्धे चरणौ पितुः ।तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणतं पार्श्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटं नृपः ॥२-३-३३॥
transliteration: nāma svaṁ śrāvayan rāmo vavandhe caraṇau pituḥ ।taṁ dṛṣṭvā praṇataṁ pārśve kṛtāñjalipuṭaṁ nṛpaḥ ॥2-3-33॥

translations.english: Seeing his beloved son Rama who was standing by his side with folded hands in supplication, king Dasaratha, held his folded hands and drew him near and embraced him.
